name: Ajrasakha-Hackathon
description: Ajrasakha Hackathon project with frontend and server

scripts.install:all: bun install && bun run install:frontend && bun run install:server && bun run install:seeder && bun run install:loader && bun run install:prediction
scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run dev:frontend" "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:prediction"
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:server
scripts.prod: bun run build && bun run start:server
